about: Speaking in five (22 Nov 2026): the Writing 'in five' ladder for a Speaking Part. Five moves, one sentence each, the school's frames first (data/drills/speaking/*.json). {X} = what the pupil picks or types. 'q' on a subject is the examiner's question ({X} filled). 'secs' is the target length of the whole answer said aloud.
name: Part 2
how: A Part 2 minute in five: what the photos share, how they differ, a careful guess, another possibility, then the question answered. Same five, any photos.

nameAsk.title: What do both photos show?
nameAsk.aim: Pick how you'd say it. Your first sentence will use it.

subjects.label: Work
subjects.q: Compare the photographs and say what might be difficult for the people in these situations.
picks: people trying to get work done
subjects.scene: Photo 1: colleagues in a meeting · Photo 2: someone working alone in a café

subjects.label: Sport
subjects.q: Compare the photographs and say why the people have chosen to exercise in these ways.
subjects.scene: Photo 1: a woman running alone in a park · Photo 2: a team playing basketball

subjects.label: Holidays
subjects.q: Compare the photographs and say what the people might enjoy about these holidays.
subjects.scene: Photo 1: a family on a busy beach · Photo 2: two friends camping in the mountains

subjects.label: Learning
subjects.q: Compare the photographs and say why the people are learning in these ways.
subjects.scene: Photo 1: a class with a teacher · Photo 2: a teenager learning online at home

slots.label: What they share
slots.job: open with what both photos share

ways.t: I feel that in many ways these pictures are similar: they both show {X}.
Both pictures show {X}, but in very different ways.
The common theme in both pictures is {X}.

slots.label: How they differ
slots.job: say how the photos differ, in one sentence

ways.t: By contrast, the second picture shows …
Compared to the second picture, the first looks …

slots.label: A guess
slots.job: guess what is happening, without being too certain
slots.q: Which one makes a careful guess?

ways.t: It is likely that the people in the first picture …

slots.label: Another possibility
slots.q: Which one adds a second guess?

ways.t: On the other hand, they could be …

slots.label: Answer the question
slots.job: answer the question printed above the photos
slots.q: Which one answers the question on the page?

ways.t: So, to answer the question, I'd say …
Overall, I think the people in the second picture …
